headers.access-control-allow-headers: Authorization, Content-Digest, Content-Type, Content-Length, Depth, Destination, If, If-Match, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since, If-Unmodified-Since, Lock-Token, Overwrite, Range, Timeout, X-Requested-With
headers.access-control-allow-methods: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS, PROPFIND, PROPPATCH, MKCOL, COPY, MOVE, LOCK, UNLOCK
